data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.DisplayRotation.Help
data.value: Select landscape or portrait orientation. Manual mode uses the assigned rotation button.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.ControlOrientation.Help
data.value: Automatic mode follows the display orientation. Other modes keep the controls in the selected orientation.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.MonochromePalette.Help
data.value: Select the colors used for monochrome games.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.ColorDepth.Help
data.value: Select the output color depth. The 24-bit mode requires more processing power.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.FrameSkipping.Help
data.value: Skip video frames to reduce audio crackling. Automatic mode follows the audio buffer. Manual mode uses the selected threshold.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.FrameSkipThreshold.Help
data.value: Manual mode: skip video frames below the selected audio buffer fill level.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.FixedRefreshRate.Help
data.value: Skip every fifth frame to display at 60 Hz. This reduces motion smoothness.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.AudioSampleRate.Help
data.value: Higher sampling rates slightly improve audio quality and require more processing power.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.AudioFilter.Help
data.value: Apply a low-pass filter to soften the sound.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.SwapButtons.Help
data.value: Swap the actions of buttons A and B.

data.name: Emulation.Bandai.Setting.FrameSkipThreshold.DetailedHelp
data.value: At 33%, video frames are skipped when the audio buffer is less than 33% full, to reduce crackling. Higher values trigger skipping sooner. Audio latency and buffer size are unchanged.
